question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age
  ) = 25
  AND
  -- Check month/day: birthday must have occurred on or before 2026-09-25
  SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= '09-25'
  AND
  -- Ensure the next birthday hasn't passed yet (i.e., next birthday is after 2026-09-25)
  (
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '09-25'
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 0;

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-24
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birthday on or before 2026-09-24 and next birthday after that
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '2026-09-24')
    AND
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+1 year') > '2026-09-24')
  )
  AND
  -- Orders date within the period that includes all orders of these customers
  o.date >= '2026-09-24 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-09-25 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) =
  CASE
    -- If birthday hasn't occurred yet this year, subtract 1
    WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 6, 2) THEN 1
    WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 6, 2) AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 9, 2) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
  AND
  -- Ensure the birthday has occurred on or before 2026-09-26
  (
    (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) < SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 6, 2)) OR
    (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 6, 2) AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= SUBSTR('2026-09-26', 9, 2))
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on order.date
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(o.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
  ) = 25
  AND
  -- Ensure the birthday has occurred on or before order.date this year
  SUBSTR(o.date, 6, 5) >= SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date <= '2026-11-25' AND c.birth_date > '2025-12-01'
AND c.birth_date <= date('2026-12-01', '-' || (strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) || ' years') 
AND c.birth_date > date('2026-12-01', '-' || (strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 1) || ' years');

JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

FROM orders o

WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'

  AND c.birth_date > date('2026-09-25', '-' || CAST((strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 1) AS INTEGER) || ' years');
